description: Return information about specified External RFI revisions

id.description: Unique string identifier for this RFI revision.

title.description: Display title of the RFI revision (the formatted name of the RFI at that revision point).

current_revision.description: When `true`, this record is the most recent revision.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the RFI at this revision point.

revision.description: Sequential revision counter (e.g. `0` for original, `1` for first revision).

created_at.description: Timestamp when this revision was created, in ISO 8601 format.

time_resolved.description: Timestamp when this revision was closed, in ISO 8601 format. Null if not yet closed.

initiated_at.description: Timestamp when this revision was opened/initiated, in ISO 8601 format.

translated_status.description: Locale-translated display label for the status (e.g. `Open`, `Closed`).
